packages.label: JCodeMunch code intelligence
packages.description: Local code index with symbol search, outline, references, and context bundling. Blocks Grep/Glob and routes code exploration through jcodemunch tools.

packages.label: JDocMunch doc intelligence
packages.description: Local docs index with section search, TOC, and context retrieval. Routes doc exploration through jdocmunch tools instead of reading full files.

packages.label: Blog skill
packages.description: Bundles the blog skill via a skill component — demonstrates a package whose payload is a shared skill link.

packages.label: Code intelligence (preset)
packages.description: Composite preset: enables both the jcodemunch code index and the jdocmunch doc index together. A preset is just a package that requires other packages.

packages.label: Telemetry
packages.description: Capture and visualize token usage across harnesses. Wires capture hooks and a local spool; the dashboard server is started separately with `roborepo telemetry serve`.

packages.label: Caveman plugin
packages.description: Claude plugin that keeps agent output terse to cut token use (statusline badge, /caveman commands, mode-tracker hook). The caveman behavior rule is separate and lives in the global rules.
